policy: Exact EVSE-level evidence only. The Neubeckum ORLEN HPC EVSEs listed here expose a current 0.58 EUR/kWh direct/ad-hoc price through Eco-Movement data delivered via Mobilithek under AFIR and surfaced with EVSE IDs by ladestau.de. No DE*ODE-wide fallback is inferred: other ORLEN sites/snapshots show different prices, so unresolved ORLEN EVSEs remain unpriced until independently verified.
